rulings.raw: ¾ cup Mexican crema, (plus more if you want it extra creamy)
rulings.evidence: Board reports no commodity and no capture. Cultured table cream is its own 15 oz Hispanic-dairy SKU, not sour cream, so a new id is proposed rather than a bridge; 630 g at batch scale is far too much to leave pantry-static.

cooked-shredded-chicken is a live board id (3 of 7, cheapest 0.3744 Aldi) that names exactly this food, so a reuse and not a proposal; only the vocabulary name row is missing. Preferred over the 'cooked chicken' -> rotisserie-chicken precedent because a purpose-built id exists.

REFUSED the board's shredded-cheese bridge - that id prices bagged cheddar/blend and the estate refused the same bridge twice on 2026-08-26 (parmesan, mozzarella). Queso Chihuahua is a specialty 10-12 oz melting cheese at a higher price class.
Garnish line with no stated quantity, so optional; onions is live 7 of 7 and the 'med onion' -> onions precedent binds. Weighed as half a medium onion.
